items.description: Heavy hits trigger an ice burst; has a cooldown.

items.name: Kjaro’s Band

items.name: AtG Missile Mk. 1
items.description: Hits can launch a damaging missile.

items.name: Will-o’-the-wisp
items.description: Kills trigger an explosion around the victim.

items.name: Shatterspleen
items.description: Critical hits bleed; bleeding enemies explode on death.

items.name: Predatory Instincts
items.description: Critical hits build temporary attack speed.

items.name: Luminous Shot
items.description: Secondary uses charge lightning for your primary.

rows.title: Not Good
rows.summary: Lower priority here; useful in other builds.

items.name: Bustling Fungus
items.description: Standing still creates a healing zone.

items.name: Hooks of Heresy
items.description: Replaces your secondary skill with Slicing Maelstrom.

items.name: Essence of Heresy
items.description: Replaces your special skill with Ruin.

items.name: Warbanner
items.description: Level-ups and teleporter starts create a speed zone.

legend.text: Relative copy weight, NOT an in-game percentage.
1 copy : 5 copies; weights do not sum to 100.
Do not actively target; still usable if found.
